notes.TWN: 台灣不在 AQUASTAT 中。改用經濟部水利署公布的 2013–2022 年平均可利用逕流量 633.7 億立方公尺（年降雨 885 億立方公尺、2,458 公釐，扣除蒸發與入滲），除以聯合國的年中人口。AQUASTAT 的可再生水資源是長期平均的地表水加地下水（扣除重疊的部分）；台灣的值只有地表逕流，不含沒有流入河川的地下水補注，可能略為低估

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan is not in AQUASTAT. The Water Resources Agency's average available runoff for 2013–2022, 63.37 billion m³ (annual rainfall of 88.5 billion m³ or 2,458 mm, minus evaporation and infiltration), is divided by the UN mid-year population. AQUASTAT's renewable resources are long-term averages of surface water plus groundwater (minus the overlap); Taiwan's figure is surface runoff only, without groundwater recharge that does not reach rivers, so it may be slightly low
